findings.title: password_hash return value not checked before use
findings.recommendation: Check for false return from password_hash and throw a RuntimeException instead of inserting a false/empty hash into the database.

findings.title: Rehash UPDATE result not checked
findings.evidence: no row-count or error check after the rehash update
findings.recommendation: Verify $update->rowCount() is 1 (or catch PDOException) so a failed rehash does not silently leave the old hash; consider logging the mismatch.

findings.title: Email not normalized, duplicate insert raises raw PDO exception
findings.evidence: insert relies on DB unique constraint to reject duplicates
findings.recommendation: Normalize (trim/lowercase) the email before insert and catch the unique-constraint PDOException to surface a domain error instead of an unhandled database exception, which also avoids account-enumeration via error text.

findings.title: Timing cover only within a single process
findings.evidence: static dummy hash is created once per process, so cost may differ from stored hashes
findings.recommendation: Acceptable as-is, but consider generating the dummy hash with the same algorithm/cost as PASSWORD_DEFAULT at deploy time so verify time is comparable even if defaults change between the hash creation and now.
